children: was among the standout U.S. stocks Tuesday morning, rising more than 12% as broader equity markets advanced and major indexes reached record levels.

The S&P 500 gained about 0.81%, while the Nasdaq Composite added roughly 0.10%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average climbed about 0.5%. Technology shares remained an important source of support, while investors monitored upcoming comments from Federal Reserve officials.
Market gains were broad, with nine of the 11 major S&P 500 sectors trading higher. Utilities led the advancing groups, while energy shares lagged as crude oil prices declined.

Bond markets also pointed lower during morning trading. The two-year Treasury yield eased two basis points to 4.78%, and the 10-year yield dropped four basis points to 5.26%. The 30-year yield was down two basis points at 5.64%.

Seagate Technology (STX) was one of the weaker individual names, falling more than 7% in morning trading. The moves came as investors continued weighing technology-sector momentum alongside interest-rate expectations.

title: Constellation Energy Leads S&P 500 to Record Peak
